mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipping_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipping_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM shipping_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
